security.title: Privacy that doesn't rely on trust
security.lead: Encryption happens in your browser. Not even the SparkChat server can read conversations between people.

keys.title: Your keys are born on your device
keys.text: When you create your account, the browser generates your key pair. The private key only leaves it protected by your password.

encrypt.title: Every message is encrypted before it's sent
encrypt.text: Text, photos, voice messages and files travel encrypted, from your browser to their destination.

relay.title: The server only delivers
relay.text: It stores and forwards the encrypted content without being able to read what was written.

read.title: Only people in the conversation can read it
read.text: The message only becomes readable again on the devices of those in the conversation.

security.recoveryNote: When you create your account you get a recovery file. Keep it safe: it's how you sign in on another device without losing your history.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What usually comes up before the first message.

free.question: Is SparkChat free?
free.answer: Yes. To create an account you just pick an avatar, a username and a password. No credit card, no trial period.

install.question: Do I need to install anything?
install.answer: No. SparkChat runs in the browser, on your computer or phone. If you like, you can add it to your home screen.

encryption.question: How does the encryption work?
encryption.answer: Messages and attachments are encrypted in your browser with keys only the conversation participants can use. The server delivers the content but can't read it.

recovery.question: What is the recovery file?
recovery.answer: It's a file generated when you create your account that lets you sign in on another device without losing your encrypted history. Keep it somewhere safe: without it and your password, the messages can't be recovered.

assistant.question: Are conversations with SparkAI encrypted too?
assistant.answer: To reply, the assistant has to read what you write, so those messages are processed by the server and the AI model. Conversations between people stay end-to-end encrypted.

theme.question: Does the theme I pick here carry over to the app?
theme.answer: The light or dark mode you pick here already applies to the sign-in screen. Inside the app, you choose color, mode and wallpaper in the appearance menu, and your choice follows your account on every device.
